title: Mulch of dung
html_source: Animal and human faeces come up several times in Calypso. Here it is presented through Bloom’s apparent pragmatic and curious mind. It is given a different spin in Penelope/ Chapter 18.

anchor.prefix: is this that is? The hens in the next garden: their droppings are very good top dressing. Best of1986#55 all though are the cattle, especially when they are fed on those oilcakes.
